summary: Destroys two embedded singly-linked lists with node wrappers. Optionally closes a Win32 handle stored at this+0x20 when the flag at this+0x28 is set, zeroing the handle field. First pass frees list1 (head at this+0x10): for each node, if the node flag at node+0x8 is set and node+0x0 holds a data pointer, calls the data object's vtable[0] with argument 1, then frees the data via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Second pass frees list2 (head at this+0x0): for each node with flag set, frees the wrapped data object via its vtable[0] with argument 3 and frees both data and node. Both lists' head/tail/cursor/count fields (this+0x0..0x1C) are zeroed.

local_names.v1: list2 head pointer held in this+0x0
local_names.v2: pointer to list1 head field at this+0x10
local_names.v7: data object pointed to by a list2 node

operations.description: If the flag at this+0x28 is non-zero and CloseHandle(this+0x20) succeeds, the handle field this+0x20 is zeroed
Iterate list1 starting at head this+0x10, following node link at node+0x0, until a null cursor
For each list1 node: if the node flag at node+0x8 is set and the node's data pointer at node+0x0 is non-null, invoke the data object's vtable[0] with argument 1
Free each list1 node wrapper via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Zero list1 fields this+0x10, this+0x14, this+0x18, this+0x1C after the pass
Iterate list2 starting at head this+0x0, following node link at node+0x0, until a null cursor

For each list2 node with the flag at node+0x8 set: if the node holds a data pointer at node+0x0, and that data object's vtable is non-null, invoke the data object's vtable[0] with argument 3 and free the data object via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Free each list2 node wrapper itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf
Zero list2 fields this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8, this+0xC after the pass
Returns after both lists are emptied and all list fields are zeroed
